title: Trailhead Field Notes
success_evidence: Markup saved in a synthetic field note is later emitted unencoded on the shared reviews page.
root_cause: The lesson variant treats stored user content as trusted HTML during rendering.
mitigation: Encode untrusted content for the HTML context and retain a restrictive content security policy.

juice_shop_reference.lesson: Transfer stored-XSS source-to-storage-to-sink reasoning to field notes.
